questions.question: As of 26th January 2021, who is the Lok Sabha Speaker? 26 जनवरी 2021 तक लोकसभा अध्यक्ष कौन है?
questions.solution: As of 26th January 2021, Shri Om Birla is the Speaker of Lok Sabha. Shri G.V. Mavalankar was the first Speaker of Lok Sabha (15 May 1952- 27 February 1956).

Sharath M. Gayakwad is an Indian Paralympic swimmer from Bangalore. At the 2014 Asian Games, he broke P.T. Usha's record for most number of medals by an Indian at any multi-discipline event by winning 6 medals. Coming from a modest financial background, he has over 30 international and 40 national medals to his credit, one of them being the bronze medal at the 2010 Asian Para Games. He is the first Indian swimmer to qualify for the Paralympics and competed in the 2012 Summer Paralympics in London.

The effect of splitting of a spectral line into several components in the presence of a static magnetic field is called the Zeeman effect. It is named after the Dutch physicist Pieter Zeeman, who discovered it in 1896 and won a Nobel prize for this discovery.

The Security Council has five permanent members - China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States. The Security Council consists of fifteen members, of which five are permanent. India began 8th term as non-permanent UNSC member in January 2021.

Jadopatia painting is a type of folk art that is popular in the villages of Jharkhand's Dumka district. The word 'Jadopatia' means 'Magic Painters.' The paintings are created by Bengali painters known as 'Chitrakars,' which means 'picture-makers.'
Chennai Super Kings, an Indian Premier League franchise cricket team based in Chennai. The CSK team is led by MS Dhoni. Owned by Chennai Super Kings Cricket Ltd

NITI Aayog, along with the Institute for Competitiveness, released the second edition of the India Innovation Index in January 2021. The report examines the innovation capabilities and performance of the states and union territories. The first edition of the index was launched in October 2019. In the 'Major States' category, Karnataka continued to occupy the top position, while Maharashtra moved past Tamil Nadu to reach the second place. Telangana, Kerala, Haryana, Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh and Punjab completed the top ten in that order.

Anchar Lake is a lake located near Soura area in the city of Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India. Situated close to Ganderbal, the lake is connected with the famous Dal Lake via a channel "Amir Khan Nallah" which passes through Gilsar and Khushal Sar.

In the periodic table, the highly electronegative halogens and the highly electropositive alkali metals are separated by noble gases.

The six naturally occurring noble gases are helium (He), neon (Ne), argon (Ar), krypton (Kr), xenon (Xe), and the radioactive radon (Rn).

Ecological diversity (also called ecosystem diversity) is usually considered to be a type of biodiversity and deals with the variations within or across ecosystems. It can encompass factors such as the number of ecological niches, the trophic levels, and/or the physical complexity of the ecosystem(s), in addition to the richness and diversity of the species that inhabit it. Deserts, rain forests, coral reefs and mangroves are features of Ecological diversity.

Topaz is an aluminum silicate containing fluorine and has a chemical formula of Al2(F,OH)2SiO4. It is formed by fluorine-bearing vapours given off during the last stages of the crystallization of igneous rocks. It typically occurs in cavities in rhyolites and granite, in pegmatite dikes, and in high-temperature veins.

Samudragupta (335-375 AD) of the Gupta dynasty is known as the Napoleon of India. Historian A V Smith called him so because of his great military conquests known from the 'Prayag Prashati' written by his courtier and poet Harisena, who also describes him as the hero of a hundred battles.

Surendranath Banerjee laid the foundations of the Indian National Movement by founding the Indian Association at Calcutta in 1876 along with Ananda Mohan Bose. The objectives of this Association were "promoting by every legitimate means the political, intellectual and material advancement of the people".

The 51st edition of the International Film Festival of India, Goa conferred Biswajit Chatterjee, veteran actor, producer, director and singer of Hindi and Bengali cinema, with the Indian Personality of the Year Award, in Goa on January 24, 2021.

Biswajit Chatterjee is known for his roles of Kumar Vijay Singh in Bees Saal Baad, Raja Amit Kumar Singh in musical drama Kohra, Ashok in romantic film April Fool, Ramesh Kumar in Mere Sanam, Jeevan in Night In London, Shekhar in Do Kaliyaan and Vicky in Kismat.

An international paragliding festival was held at Vagamon in Kerala on April 6th,7th and 8th. The event is jointly organized by Kerala Tourism and the Adventure Sports and Sustainable Tourism Academy (ASSTA).

'Swasthya Sathi' scheme is the health insurance scheme that covers the entire population of West Bengal. Introduced by the West Bengal Chief Minister in 2016, the Swasthya Sathi Scheme has been enacted to provide cashless medical treatment to residents of West Bengal. The key benefits of the scheme include a health cover of Rs. 5 Lakhs, cashless hospitalisation, and zero premium coverage.

The Constitution (Eighty-sixth Amendment) Act, 2002 inserted Article 21-A in the Constitution of India to provide free and compulsory education of all children in the age group of six to fourteen years as a Fundamental Right in such a manner as the State may, by law, determine.

questions.question: When is the statehood day of Tripura observed? त्रिपुरा का राज्यत्व दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.solution: Statehood Day is celebrated every year as Manipur, Meghalaya, and Tripura on January 21 as they attained statehood under the North Eastern Region (Reorganization) Act of 1971. Earlier before the north-eastern region was turned into seven sisters with the statehood of Manipur, Tripura, Meghalaya, Assam, Mizoram, Arunachal Pradesh, and Nagaland, the North Eastern composition consisted of Assam plains from the old Assam Province, the hill districts, and the North Eastern Frontier Tracts (NEFT) of the North-Eastern borderland.

Meghalaya won the National Award for Best Electoral Practices 2020. The Office of the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) Meghalaya was selected for a Special Award for Information Technology (IT) applications in Elections by the Election Commission of India (ECI), in the National Best Electoral Practices Awards 2020.

Duduma Falls plunges from a height of more than 550 feet and is located on the border of Odisha and Andhra pradesh. It is located 70 km from Jeypore town in the Koraput district of Odisha. It is formed by the Machkund river. Duduma Falls is one of the tallest 'plunge' type waterfalls in India and holds the third rank in Odisha in terms of the height of the water column.

The Rajasthan government in January 2021 brought the much-awaited policy on manufactured sand (M-sand), giving industry status to the units producing it for construction work and reducing the dependence on bajri (riverbed sand).

The revolt in the countryside of the Bombay Deccan occurred in 1875. In May and June 1875, peasants of Maharashtra in some parts of Pune and Ahmednagar districts revolted against increasing agrarian distress.

Stomach secretes hydrochloric acid that helps our body in killing pathogenic bacteria. It is secreted by parietal cells in the stomach.Excessive secretion of stomach acid can lead to the formation of peptic ulcers.

SHG: Self Help Group.

Self-Help Group refers to self-governed, peer controlled, informal group of people with same socio-economic background and having a desire to collectively perform common purposes. Here poor people voluntarily come together to save whatever amount they can save conveniently out of their earnings, to mutually agree to contribute to a common fund and to lend to the members for meeting their productive and emergent needs.

Shaukat Ali was one of the leaders who was instrumental in convincing Mahatma Gandhi about the need to start a non-cooperation movement in support of The Khilafat.

Khilafat movemen was a pan-Islamic force in India that arose in 1919 in an effort to salvage the Ottoman caliph as a symbol of unity among the Muslim community in India during the British raj. The movement was initially bolstered by Gandhi's noncooperation movement but fell apart after the abolition of the caliphate in 1924.

The combined Khilafat Non-Cooperation movement was the first all-India agitation against British rule.

Amount given to Ashok = 150 * 5 = Rs. 750

Alternate method:

Part of work done by Samir and Puneet in 5 days = 5(1/10 + 1/15) = 5/6

Remaining 1/6th part of work was done by Ashok

Amount given to Ashok = 1/6 * 4500 = Rs.750

questions.question: Select the option that will substitute the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no substitution is needed, select 'No substitution required'. Among applied sciences, medicine is one which have given man some power over death.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that will substitute the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no substitution is needed, select 'No substitution required'.

Among applied sciences, medicine is one which have given man some power over death.
questions.solution:
In the given sentence, the usage of the helping verb 'have' is incorrect. There is a singular noun 'medicine' which is being referred to here, so the helping verb used with it also must be singular. 'Have' needs to be replaced by 'has' in the sentence. Also, the given sentence is talking about one particular medicine that has given man some power over death, so article 'the' should be used prior to the word 'one'. 'The' before a noun shows that what is referred to is already known to the speaker, listener, writer and/or reader.

Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. Whichever soonest made a traveller take off his cloak should be accounted the more powerful. B. They agreed to put the point to test. C. A dispute once arose between the wind and the sun to decide which was the stronger of the two. D. The wind began, and blew with all his might and sent a blast, cold and fierce as a storm.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Whichever soonest made a traveller take off his cloak should be accounted the more powerful.

B. They agreed to put the point to test.

C. A dispute once arose between the wind and the sun to decide which was the stronger of the two.

D. The wind began, and blew with all his might and sent a blast, cold and fierce as a storm.
questions.solution: If we read the sentences closely, we can notice that C and B make a pair; C following B as B describes a situation in which a dispute arose between the wind and the sun arguing who had more power out of the two, and C talks about how they decide to resolve the issue. A and D also make a pair; D followed by A as D describes the condition which was fixed to determine who would get the tittle of being stronger, and D explains what the wind did in order to win the battle. Rearranging the sentences in the order of CBAD, makes a coherent paragraph. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. I was shocked to find my house unlocked. B. To my astonishment, I found that my son, who had a spare key, had come in my absence. C. Last Sunday I returned home late at night. D. I ran inside in fear that my house has been robbed.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. I was shocked to find my house unlocked.

B. To my astonishment, I found that my son, who had a spare key, had come in my absence.

C. Last Sunday I returned home late at night.

D. I ran inside in fear that my house has been robbed.
questions.solution: If we read the sentences closely, we can notice that C and A make a pair; A following C, as C talks about the previous Sunday when a person returned home late and A describes what happened upon his reaching home. These two sentences together build a story to some extent. D and B also make a pair; D followed by B as D describes the person running into his house in fear, thinking that his house has been robbed and B then explains that to his astonishment and an obvious relief he found his son sitting inside who had used a spare key to enter the house. Rearranging the sentences in the order of CADB, makes a coherent paragraph. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.
